title: Music mini player prev/next track buttons
summary: Compact music PiP gains icon-only SkipBack/SkipForward beside play/pause, reusing the same adjacent-track handlers as the full panel.
testFocus: Prev/next icons flank play/pause; no visible Korean/English labels
Prev disabled on first track (non-shuffle); next disabled on last when not play-all/shuffle
Tapping prev/next changes track and continues playback when already playing
asIs: Mini player only had play/pause, expand, close
toBe: Mini player also has icon-only previous/next track controls
